coastal.title: Firefighters dealing with abandoned, 'intentionally-set' fires on Sunshine Coast
coastal.description: "We are monitoring the situation very, very closely in regards to enacting a campfire prohibition," said fire Chief Dwight Davison.

kamloops.title: Summerland residents begin returning home as roughly 1,200 properties cleared for re-entry
kamloops.description: After more than a week, some Summerland residents are finally walking back through their front doors.

kamloops.title: Evacuation order lifted for majority of Summerland, more than 1 week after wildfire forced residents to flee
kamloops.description: "This is the big day," said Summerland Mayor Doug Holmes, with thousands of residents allowed to make their way home Tuesday to assess what damage the Bald Range fire has caused their community.

kamloops.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 18
kamloops.description: Thousands of Summerland residents were given the go-ahead to return home on Tuesday as the district lifted the majority of evacuation orders related to the Bald Range fire.

kamloops.title: B.C. farmer who fled wildfire teams up with chef on sauces to support other producers
kamloops.description: A B.C. chef and a local farmer who lost his home to the raging Bald Range wildfire have teamed up on a project to support other producers hit hard by fires this summer.

prince-george.title: How studying driver behaviour could make wildfire evacuations in northern B.C. safer
prince-george.description: A UNBC PhD candidate is studying how drivers respond during simulated wildfire evacuations on Highway 97 north of Prince George. The research will help build a traffic model that could help emergency planners understand congestion, travel times and road closures before an evacuation happens.

all.title: B.C.’s provincial health officer to hold news conference amid wildfire smoke warnings
all.description: B.C. provincial health officer Dr. Bonnie Henry is set to hold a news conference Tuesday as much of the southern half of the province remains blanketed in wildfire smoke.

all.title: Simon Fraser University Pipe Band wins World Pipe Band Championships in Scotland
all.description: For the first time in 17 years, the Simon Fraser University Pipe Band has won the global title at the World Pipe Band Championships held in Glasgow, Scotland.
